steps: With a real HaloPSA sandbox/test tenant (needs a real vendor account -- not available in this environment, per mcp-track.md 2.5 this does not block design or dev), call halopsa_users_search for a known contact and note its id
Call halopsa_tickets_create with that id as user_id, plus a valid client_id and tickettype_id
Call halopsa_tickets_get for the returned ticket id
expect: The ticket returned by halopsa_tickets_get shows user_id equal to the id passed at creation, and (if HaloPSA fills them) user_name/user_email for that same contact.
evidence: needs a real vendor account; not executed in this environment. Tracked in the design doc's Open questions / Test strategy as the one assumption (bare user_id is sufficient on write) that is not independently verified against a live tenant.
